import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import xarray as xr

ds = xr.Dataset(coords={"a": np.array([0], dtype="i4")})
print("original coord dtype:", ds["a"].values.dtype)

stacked = ds.stack(b=("a",))
print("stacked level coord dtype:", stacked["a"].values.dtype)
print("stacked dim coord dtype:", stacked["b"].values.dtype)
print("equal?", ds["a"].values.dtype == stacked["a"].values.dtype)
print("stacked variables:", {k: (v.dims, v.dtype) for k, v in stacked.variables.items()})
print("xindexes:", stacked.xindexes)
mi = stacked.xindexes["b"]
print("multiindex level dtypes:", [lev.dtype for lev in mi.index.levels])
print("multiindex codes dtypes:", [np.asarray(c).dtype for c in mi.index.codes])
print("get_level_values dtype:", mi.index.get_level_values("a").dtype)
print("level_coords_dtype:", mi.level_coords_dtype)

# pandas-side check of the stack() machinery
lev = pd.Index(np.array([0], dtype="i4"))
codes, levels = lev.factorize()
print("factorize -> levels dtype:", levels.dtype, "codes dtype:", codes.dtype)
new_mi = pd.MultiIndex([levels], [codes], names=["a"])
print("pd.MultiIndex levels dtype:", [l.dtype for l in new_mi.levels])
print("pd.MultiIndex get_level_values dtype:", new_mi.get_level_values("a").dtype)
EOF
